subject.title: fix: prioritize exhausted Antigravity quota in menu bar and highest usage

question: Should automatic Antigravity selection use context-specific semantics—reset-focused menu-bar selection but maximum-usage Overview ranking—or one shared most-constrained/usable-lane policy everywhere?
rationale: Current docs and tests do not establish which lane should win across reset, percentage, pace, and highest-usage contexts, and each option changes what existing users see when one family is exhausted while another remains usable.

options.title: Approve context-specific ranking
options.body: Keep reset-focused menu selection and maximum-usage Overview ranking, while fixing family classification and documenting the distinction.

options.title: Use one constrained lane
options.body: Select the same exhausted or highest-used quota lane for both menu-bar display and Overview ranking.

options.title: Prefer usable capacity
options.body: Continue skipping exhausted lanes while another model family remains usable, preserving the earlier actionable-capacity behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve context-specific ranking
recommendation.body: Keep reset-focused menu selection and maximum-usage Overview ranking, while fixing family classification and documenting the distinction.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a cross-consumer menu-bar product contract rather than a purely mechanical implementation choice.
